title: Relative normalization of a finite affine coproduct
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, and D_i a finite family indexed by Fin(r) of commutative A-algebras. Suppose a qcqs morphism f:X -> Spec A [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] has an isomorphism e:X ≅ coproduct_i Spec D_i over Spec A. Then the coproduct of the relative normalizations of Spec D_i -> Spec A is isomorphic to f.normalization. For each i, the summand inclusion followed by this isomorphism and f.fromNormalization equals the structural map from the i-th normalization. No Artinian, reduced or nonempty assumption is required.

proof.text: For every component use normalizationDesc to map its normalization to f.normalization. Its factorization equation is the given equality over Spec A. Assemble these maps to a coproduct map a.

Prove the structural map b from the finite coproduct of component normalizations to Spec A integral by induction on Fin r: empty source gives a closed immersion, and a successor coproduct splits into first summand and tail, to which the integral binary-coproduct instance applies. Assemble the component toNormalization maps to v:X -> coproduct_i N_i, so f=v followed by b. Apply normalizationDesc to obtain a reverse map z.

The normalizationDesc equations show both maps commute with source maps and structural maps. Apply normalization.hom_ext on f.normalization to prove z followed by a is the identity, and on each component normalization followed by Sigma.hom_ext for the other direction. normalizationDesc_comp gives every summand structural equation.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_affine_normalization_coproduct
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → Type u)
    [∀ i, CommRing (D i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (D i)]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec A) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (e : X ≅ ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (D i)))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (D i)))) = f) :
    ∃ n : (∐ fun i : Fin r ↦
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (D i)))).normalization) ≅
        f.normalization,
      ∀ i : Fin r,
        Sigma.ι _ i ≫ n.hom ≫ f.fromNormalization =
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (D i)))).fromNormalization
